title: Lens Library
tagline: A scientific hub for share your ideas, write your opinion, own your content and be rewarded for your contribution
description:
**The Problem**

Access to articles with high scientific value content are found within expensive platforms, with curating, production and evaluation processes that become increasingly difficult to access in order to generate knowledge and obtain it in the best way. How are we going to learn, how are we going to develop if we do not have the necessary tools to encourage our creativity?

**Solution**

Create a hub of high impact content journals, NFTs, DeFI and original publications that can be reviewed with your wallet or your Lens.

**Curation mechanism**

We will use The Graph algorithm to find the publications with the highest impact, according to which the content will be broadcast on the hub to be able to access it. The participants of the protocol that use it the most will be rewarded with different tiers, to be able to access the paid content articles, which will be sponsored by the protocol.

The base of the whole project is based on writing citations of these high impact scientific articles in a simple, digestible and communicable language, thus allowing more people to have access to high value information.

You can log in to Lens on the hub to become a curator of high-impact articles and gain social reputation. With different batches as you get more impact and reputation.
how_its_made:
We are using the capability of lens protocol to post large content in a blog manner, but intend to be with a more scientific approach, using embed Wallet Connect, Lens protocol ID, and a SubGraph to fetch the information.
